CPU_metric: shutdown_process_cpu_ns_per_op = lifecycle-inclusive process E-A divided by measured transactions; not isolated steady state
M1: three arms; 18 runs per case; all six permutations; direct final/before, final/cgo, before/cgo
M2: two methods on current production; 12 processes and 36 testing.B mean samples per case; three repeats clustered within process

client_harness_compatibility.scope: cleanup-chain drain and matching validator only; no workload/timing/pacing/numeric-estimator change

historical: separate cohort description only; no pooled blocks, cross-cohort CI, or ratio-of-ratios
interval: nominal 95% paired-block percentile; no multiplicity adjustment
sanitization: aggregate estimates only; no raw transactions, host traces, addresses, cloud identifiers, private paths or credentials
